subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android intentionally retire the visible Voice destination and make Chat the sole entry surface for realtime Talk and inline dictation?
rationale: This is a user-facing navigation and interaction-model change, not a narrow correction to an established contract; source review cannot establish whether the product should replace Voice rather than preserve it as a separate destination.

options.title: Sponsor unified Chat
options.body: Accept Chat as the sole visible destination after exact-head proof covers dictation and both Talk setup states.

options.title: Keep Voice discoverable
options.body: Retain a visible Voice destination or an explicit migration/discoverability path while sharing the existing Talk runtime.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Land only the independently acceptable dictation work and defer the Voice-to-Chat navigation redesign.

recommendation.title: Sponsor unified Chat
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the sole visible destination after exact-head proof covers dictation and both Talk setup states.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to Solvely-Colin, who also authored the dictation implementation commit and is the closest identified routing candidate for the Android direction decision.
